decision.title: The Kotlin full surface: XQuery, XSLT, XSD, the DUCET resource, U+0000 (packet )
decision.summary: The Kotlin package gains XQuery, XSLT and XSD over the host shim's full-module entry points and a DUCET class path resource, and the host shim refuses U+0000, U+FFFE and U+FFFF in strings.

body.p: , after , , , , , , . Packet added the rest of the task file's Kotlin API to dev.tinyactors.sxml, over the host shim's full-module entry points.

item.p: API (defaults under ):
compileQuery(query, namespaces, baseUri) gives an XQuery with evaluate(context, variables, updates, messages), serialize(value), run(...) and isUpdating.

UpdateSink(updatedTree, putDocument) is a class of two optional functions, as Swift's struct (): "without a putDocument" is a null argument. UpdatedTree and PutDocument are AutoCloseable; PutDocument.serialize() uses method xml without parameters.

compileStylesheet(stylesheet, baseUri, staticParameters) (a String or a ByteArray) gives a Stylesheet. transform(...) takes JavaScript's options as named arguments, args included, and returns an AutoCloseable TransformResult (output, value, resultDocuments). InitialMode is Named(name) or Unnamed.
ResultDelivery carries sxml_xslt_result_delivery's numbers; ValidationMode and Validity are in the C enums' order.

compileSchema takes a list of SchemaDocument (Text(text or bytes, uri), Resolved(uri)), one document, or a text. Schema.validate has three overloads: a Value (no uri), a String and a ByteArray. ValidationResult is AutoCloseable.

Deviation from Swift (): SchemaException is a subclass of SxmlException, as JavaScript's SchemaError is of SxmlError, so catch (error: SxmlException) also catches a schema that does not compile. Swift's SchemaError is a separate struct. 6.12 compares.

Callbacks (messages, the sink) run after the call and outside the processor's lock, with the failure read first, so they may use the processor. A callback that throws leaves the values it was not given to the cleaner or to the processor's close.
Glue: seven entry points (queryCompile, queryEvaluate, querySerialize, stylesheetCompile, transform, schemaCompile, schemaValidate), 17 in all, each (JNIEnv *, jclass, jobject).

Side results come back flat in NativeSideResults (per side result: a kind, three texts, two value handles, three numbers), the field of the base class SideResultRequest, so one field ID serves every request. Kotlin adopts the values under the lock. With a JVM exception pending, the glue releases them and the result in C.
Bindings are NativeBindings (names in pairs, one handle each). CompileRequest serves XPath and XQuery (a query writes isUpdating); QuerySerializeRequest extends SerializeRequest.
HandleKind gains QUERY, STYLESHEET, SCHEMA. One internal NativeHandle holds a handle, its tracking and its cleaner registration for all five object kinds.

DUCET: CMake copies third_party/unicode-collation/allkeys.txt to resources/dev/tinyactors/sxml/allkeys.txt in the build tree (also under Android, for 6.6). The test puts that directory on the class path (SXML_KOTLIN_RESOURCES).

Host shim (6d2a997): sxml_host_string checks UTF-8 with sxml_string_from_utf8 (INVALID_UTF8) and refuses U+0000, U+FFFE and U+FFFF (INVALID_ARGUMENT), the XML 1.1 Char rule that fn:codepoints-to-string uses, as sxml_host.h says. It passed both before (found by ). All three bindings see the change. Test: string_refuses_characters_xml_does_not_allow.

Leaks under the sanitizers: the debug preset's ASAN_OPTIONS (halt_on_error=1) replaced the script's detect_leaks=0, so LeakSanitizer failed kotlin/jvm on the JVM's own allocations at exit. Replaces 's detect_leaks=0: the script appends its options, and LeakSanitizer stays on with bindings/kotlin/lsan-jvm.supp. That file suppresses only the JVM's allocator, launcher and zlib frames, so a leak of the glue, the shim or the library is still reported.
Tests: ctest kotlin/jvm (debug, ASan, -Xcheck:jni) passes 65 with 0 leaks (was 36). The run takes 77 s.

FullTest.kt has the 25 cases of full.test.ts by name: 10 XQuery, 8 XSLT, 5 XSD, the processor-close case and the full allocation-failure loop. The core-module refusal has no counterpart: the library has every language.

Binding cases: time zone and locale data through the resolver (from third_party/tzdata/zoneinfo and third_party/cldr/common), the bundled DUCET, never-closed queries, stylesheets and schemas collected, and results, trees and documents closed by use {}.
The task file's examples (Kotlin and Swift) now serialize by the text method ("XPath 2027"). The JSON method raised SERE0023 on two items.

For 6.6: run allSuites (packageSuites, fullSuites, bindingSuites) from the instrumented test. Pack resources/dev/tinyactors/sxml/allkeys.txt (or the vendored file) as a Java resource of the AAR. The resource-data cases read third_party/ through sxml.sourceDirectory; on a device, skip them or ship the files as test assets. Keep the request classes, NativeSideResults, NativeBindings and their fields in the consumer ProGuard rules: the glue looks them up by name.
